tasks.name: build
tasks.description: Build Ravel and the local runner

tasks.name: check
tasks.description: Check formatting, lint all targets and test the Rust workspace

tasks.name: install
tasks.description: Install and verify Ravel, Rhai examples and Rust notices under PREFIX (default ~/.local)

tasks.name: notices
tasks.description: Generate Rust dependency notices from the locked release graph; refuse unapproved licences

tasks.name: setup
tasks.description: Fetch and verify the pinned checkout-local book tools (Bun, mdBook, Typst with CeTZ and figure fonts)

tasks.name: smoke
tasks.description: Build, install and smoke-test a fresh temporary prefix, direct and symlinked

tasks.name: test
tasks.description: Run the runner and session-runtime suites with nextest

tasks.name: book:bun:integrity
tasks.description: Verify the checkout-local book Bun fetch, cache recovery and refusal of corrupt downloads offline

tasks.name: book:integrity
tasks.description: Verify the pinned mdBook fetch, cache reuse and refusal of a bad download offline

tasks.name: docs:book
tasks.description: Build the book, then serve it on localhost and rebuild on change (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:book:build
tasks.description: Build the book under target/book and fail on any mdBook error or warning (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:breaks
tasks.description: Report each run of prose in a chapter of the book that is longer than 450 words (-- --strict FILE... fails on a long run; needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:breaks:test
tasks.description: Prove the prose-break check passes a run at the limit and fails a longer run, that a figure, table or code block breaks a run and a heading or list does not, and that each removed rule fails a control (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:examples
tasks.description: Build Ravel, run every complete example under docs/book/src through the CLI test seam and compare output exactly (-- PAGE-OR-DIR... checks those instead; needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:examples:mutants
tasks.description: Remove one safeguard at a time from a copy of the example checker and show a control fail for each (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:examples:test
tasks.description: Prove the example check passes the fixture pages and fails a changed output, status, stale build, unlabelled block and more (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:excerpts
tasks.description: Check that every source excerpt in docs/book/src is whole lines that still occur in the tracked file it names (needs no build)

tasks.name: docs:excerpts:test
tasks.description: Prove the excerpt check passes good excerpts and fails a changed excerpt or source, a bad path, a bad label or block and more, and that each removed safeguard fails a control

tasks.name: docs:figures
tasks.description: Regenerate every book figure into a scratch directory and fail on any difference from the committed SVG or its layout record (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:figures:test
tasks.description: Prove the figure check passes unchanged fixtures and fails on a changed source, SVG, layout record, layout pin, Typst package or tool (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:figures:update
tasks.description: Rewrite the committed book figure SVGs and their .layout.json records from the Typst sources with the pinned renderer (needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:result-job
tasks.description: Serve editable result-job completion and native-entry views on localhost (Mermaid needs network access)

tasks.name: docs:rhai-configuration
tasks.description: Serve the editable Rhai configuration evaluation views of the 2.0.0 design on localhost (Mermaid needs network access)

tasks.name: docs:skills
tasks.description: Serve the editable skill directory delivery views of the 2.0.0 design on localhost (Mermaid needs network access)

tasks.name: docs:ste
tasks.description: Report where the book's text breaks the STE rules that a script can check and the word decisions in docs/book/ste.md (-- --strict FILE... fails on a problem; needs task setup)

tasks.name: docs:ste:test
tasks.description: Prove the STE check passes CONTEXT.md and SUMMARY.md and fails a planted problem for each rule, and that each removed rule fails a control (needs task setup)

tasks.name: harness:smoke:claude
tasks.description: Opt-in, spends subscription usage: make one real LLM call through Claude Code with the owner's sign-in and check the route

tasks.name: harness:smoke:codex
tasks.description: Opt-in, spends subscription usage: make one real LLM call through Codex with the owner's sign-in and check the route

tasks.name: harness:smoke:test
tasks.description: Test the harness smoke script against fake harnesses (no real call, run by task check)

tasks.name: native-entry:build
tasks.description: Build the private main-thread fixture executable for native checks

tasks.name: native-entry:front
tasks.description: Run the front's native-entry cases against the built private fixture

tasks.name: native-entry:runner
tasks.description: Run the runner's native-entry cases (library tests)

tasks.name: native-entry:start
tasks.description: Run the public Started-check API cases

tasks.name: native-linux:image
tasks.description: Build the GNU/Linux subject image for PLATFORM (arm64 native, amd64 emulated)

tasks.name: notices:setup
tasks.description: Install checkout-local cargo-about 0.8.4 and fetch locked Cargo sources for licence scanning

tasks.name: notices:test
tasks.description: Exercise real Cargo notice acceptance, refusal, atomic output and tool-version controls

tasks.name: release:archives
tasks.description: Build exact unreleased target archives (optional TARGETS), with no version cut

tasks.name: release:doctor
tasks.description: Check all release prerequisites without cutting or publishing

tasks.name: release:formula
tasks.description: Render both channels' unpublished formulae from the three unreleased archives and test each through Homebrew

tasks.name: release:lifecycle:test
tasks.description: Test independent release refusal, order, notes, dry cuts, the release channels and promotion with their mutants and the book's delivery in isolated fixtures (needs task setup)

tasks.name: release:major
tasks.description: Publish and install the next major release through CHANNEL=versioned-2 or CHANNEL=unversioned (required)

tasks.name: release:minor
tasks.description: Publish and install the next minor release through CHANNEL=versioned-2 or CHANNEL=unversioned (required)

tasks.name: release:notes
tasks.description: Fill empty Unreleased notes from commit descriptions or explicit reviewed Markdown

tasks.name: release:patch
tasks.description: Publish and install the next patch release through CHANNEL=versioned-2 or CHANNEL=unversioned (required)

tasks.name: release:promote
tasks.description: Publish the complete ravel@2 release VERSION as unversioned ravel, with no cut, build, tag or book change (READINESS and EVIDENCE default to target/release-evidence)

tasks.name: release:smoke
tasks.description: Rebuild and smoke unreleased archives on every selected target at its floors

tasks.name: release:test
tasks.description: Exercise exact archive manifest, omission/extra/type/mode controls

tasks.name: rhai:upgrade-proof
tasks.description: Prove a Rhai upgrade. Print the pin, run the rhai_* engine tests, then each hostile class in a fixed order, and fail on a missing or empty target

tasks.name: smoke:pair
tasks.description: macOS: run the installed Ravel 1.1 executable OLD and the installation under NEW at the same time, each under its own temporary HOME

tasks.name: test:cli
tasks.description: Run command-boundary tests (optional nextest arguments)

tasks.name: test:list
tasks.description: List nextest cases before selecting a run (optional package/filter arguments)

tasks.name: test:native-entry
tasks.description: Build the private main-thread fixture and run native development checks (qualification incomplete)

tasks.name: test:native-linux
tasks.description: Run current Rust, Rhai and native-entry checks on a GNU/Linux target in Docker (OUT must not exist)

tasks.name: test:runner
tasks.description: Run focused local-runner checks (optional nextest arguments)

tasks.name: test:session
tasks.description: Run focused session-runtime checks (optional nextest arguments)

tasks.name: test:terminal-recovery
tasks.description: Pair private real-PTY recovery receipts with actual front conversion/settlement
